title: Mobile autonomous robots for exploratory synthetic chemistry
summary: Mobile robots move samples between a synthesis platform, a UPLC-MS spectrometer, and a benchtop NMR, while a heuristic decision-maker evaluates data and chooses reactions. Demonstrated on structural diversification, supramolecular chemistry, and photochemical synthesis. The AI is heuristic and there is no speed or accuracy metric; the announcement says robots will not have a ‘Eureka’ moment.

evidence.tested: Mobile robots were demonstrated on three exploratory chemistry problems (structural diversification, supramolecular chemistry, photochemical synthesis); the page reports no reaction counts or accuracy metrics, only that the AI made the same or similar decisions as a human researcher.
evidence.unknown: The page reports no quantitative accuracy metrics, only two robots were used, and the system lacks a 'Eureka' moment.
evidence.ai_role: A heuristic decision-maker processes analytical data and autonomously decides whether a reaction proceeds to the next step.
